page_title: BAY 3-1 MON | Bayern Munich v B. Monchengladbach 03/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Bayern Munich quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+4' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.

90+2' Manu Kone (B. Monchengladbach) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the right post. Manuel Neuer pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
90+2' B. Monchengladbach take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+1' B. Monchengladbach have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+1' Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Corner kick. B. Monchengladbach will have an opportunity.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

89' The goalkeeper made a fine save to prevent Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) from converting his header after a dangerous cross. The ball went into the middle of the goal, where the goalkeeper was standing.
89' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bayern Munich.
89' It's time for a substitution. Grant-Leon Ranos (B. Monchengladbach) comes on in place of Franck Honorat.

86' 3 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Matthijs de Ligt (Bayern Munich) rises high to meet a cross from the free kick from Leroy Sane and heads home from the six-yard box, sending the ball in off the bar. 3:1.
85' It seemed like Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
85' Thomas Tuchel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) replacing Alphonso Davies.
85' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Rocco Reitz as he is replaced by Shio Fukuda (B. Monchengladbach).
85' Manu Kone (B. Monchengladbach) brings his opponent down. Tobias Stieler has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
84' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
82' The resulting set piece from B. Monchengladbach is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

81' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to B. Monchengladbach.
80' Great teamplay by B. Monchengladbach as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
77' The attendance for today's match is 75000.
77' B. Monchengladbach take a short corner kick.
77' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
75' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) heads on.
71' Substitution. Thomas Muller will be replaced by Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich).
70' 2 - 1 Goal! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is gifted a chance inside the box and makes no mistake putting the ball into the net with a fine header. 2:1.
67' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
66' The game is interrupted. Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
63' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Moritz Nicolas easily deals with the threat.
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Manu Kone (B. Monchengladbach) is coming onto the pitch as Florian Neuhaus cannot continue after picking up an injury.
62' That's the end of the game for Noussair Mazraoui, who is replaced by Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich).
62' Gerardo Seoane has decided to substitute Nathan Ngoumou and he is replaced by Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach).
62' Substitution. Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach) in, Luca Netz out.
60' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
58' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but Moritz Nicolas comes off his line to gather the ball.
56' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
56' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Bayern Munich.
54' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
53' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) heads the ball towards goal, but his effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
51' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
48' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the left of the target.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+2' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' 1 - 1 Thomas Muller finds Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) with a sweet pass inside the penalty box, who then smashes the ball inside the left post. What a clinical finish to make it 1:1.
43' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
41' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
40' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
39' Tobias Stieler blows his whistle and it's Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
38' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
37' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net.

35' 0 - 1 Goal! Jordan Siebatcheu manages to prod the ball to Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
34' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) beats his man to the lofted pass, but his header sails harmlessly well wide of the right post from close range.
33' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) fires the ball towards the right side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
31' A cross from a corner kick by Bayern Munich is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
31' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top right corner, but Moritz Nicolas has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
31' Bayern Munich will look to take advantage of a free kick in a promising position in the middle of the field.
30' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) receives a yellow card for infringement.
29' The corner by Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
28' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. B. Monchengladbach force their opponents to concede a corner.
28' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
26' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Moritz Nicolas, who smothers the ball.
25' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
24' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Matthijs de Ligt (Bayern Munich), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, way over the bar.
24' Bayern Munich force a corner. They send men into the box.

23' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
21' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
20' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
18' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich), but the defence gets it clear.
15' Tobias Stieler couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) and blew his whistle.
13' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
12' Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. Bayern Munich get a corner.
11' Chance! Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
10' CHANCE! Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) fires just wide of the left post from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Thomas Muller.
9' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) meets a cross inside the box, but Moritz Nicolas wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
9' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) trips an opposition player and Tobias Stieler signals a foul.
8' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
8' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
6' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) spurns a big chance! He gets to the rebound but only hits the crossbar!
5' Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
4' Dangerous play by Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach). Tobias Stieler blows his whistle for a foul.
3' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
2' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
1' The first half has just begun.
B. Monchengladbach will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Tobias Stieler.
